notes.title: New Update : Version 1.1.0 Released
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This is the first update of SincereMen, we've been working hard on fixing bugs and we hope this hotfix release will bring a more stable experience
thanks for your patiance.


News:

 Added Control Option: You can set control option first time you run the game after update, later you can change them in setting menu
 Turn ability: Now you can turn around by controller, you can enable it from control setting
 Tutorial Improved: In the turotiral now you also learn how to holster weapons and grab them
 Objectives indicator added: An arrow showes the direction of next objective
 Explosive Icons: Now explosives has icon above them to see them easier
 Weapon Recoil: Weapons recoil added when fire weapons, weapon recoil now deponds on if you holding weapon with two hands or one hand
 Warning UI: Warning UI added to tell pleayer whats awaiting him


Fixes:

 Grabbing interactables are now easier
 Visibility of scopes has improved
 Your hands will automaticly release mortar handles when you move your hands away
 Now you can grab weapons easier from your back
 Health of enemies reduced in chopper mission
 Grabbing mortar handles now deponds on the direction of your hand when you grab them
